name: CreativeClaw MCP API
description:
CreativeClaw is a remote MCP server, not a resource-oriented REST API.

Agents authenticate with OAuth 2.1 (authorization code + PKCE S256), then speak JSON-RPC 2.0 over Streamable HTTP at POST /mcp.

After `initialize`, call `tools/list` for live schemas and `tools/call` to invoke a tool.

Async tools (`generate_video`, `render_html_video`, `generate_3d_model`, `transcribe`, `isolate_audio`, `merge_media`) return a `job_id`; poll `check_job` until `status` is `completed` or `failed`.

Human docs: https://creativeclaw.co/developers/  ·  Tool catalog: https://creativeclaw.co/methods/  ·  Pricing: https://creativeclaw.co/pricing.md
